segments.sn55.34:1.2: Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, devānaṃ devapadāni avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya.
segments.sn55.34:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti –
segments.sn55.34:2.3: itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.34:2.4: Idaṃ paṭhamaṃ devānaṃ devapadaṃ avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya.
segments.sn55.34:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi … pe … samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
segments.sn55.34:4.2: Idaṃ catutthaṃ devānaṃ devapadaṃ avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya.
segments.sn55.34:4.3: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri devānaṃ devapadāni avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāyā”ti.

lines: Catutthe devapadānīti devānaṃ ñāṇena, devassa vā ñāṇena akkantapadāni.
Imasmiṃ sutte cattāropi phalaṭṭhapuggalā visuddhaṭṭhena devā nāma jātā.
Devapadānīti tesaṃ padāni devapadāni, devoti vā sammāsambuddho.
Devassa ñāṇena akkantapadānīti paṭivedhañāṇena ceva desanāñāṇena ca akkantapadāni.
